assertions.source: max over {T, ³He} of max(miss, 1/miss) for B_sym = E_0·ln(tr_free/tr_atom); exact log-trace at the DERIVED scale, no fit (post-C→D + qou-hu1f canonical trace regime: 1.28–1.58× vs 2.01× D-pin).

assertions.source: ⁴He B_AME / (2·m_e·A·8G); the doubly-magic specialization where no single hyperbolic knot (hence no per-knot trace) exists.

assertions.name: E0_beats_deuteron_pin_generic

assertions.name: B_qCLT_fac_resolves_T_3He_ordering
assertions.source: sign(B_fac(T)−B_fac(³He)) == sign(B_AME(T)−B_AME(³He)); the bond-type factorized q-CLT recovers T more bound than ³He (n-n bond L > p-p bond L), which the uniform q-CLT averages away.

description: Single-pipeline binding comparison: B_lin (linear), B_sym (exact log-trace), B_qCLT (A→∞ per-bond limit; uniform AND bond-type factorized Σ ln|V_i|) all evaluated from the ONE canonical Jones–Markov transfer trace (tr_m_atom_zn), plus B_magic (Borromean 8G) for doubly-magic ⁴He. D–⁴He from binding-canonical, ⁶Li/⁷Li computed live via the same transfer path. α = E_0 (derived) vs α_D (deuteron-pinned); E_0 wins. Δ_λ^lin vs Δ_λ^sym columns surfaced for PR #2316. No production rewire, no Δ_λ closure, no fitted coefficients.

alpha_resolution.verdict: α = E_0 (derived, parameter-free) fits the generic nuclei better than the deuteron pin: B_sym(E_0) miss 1.28–1.58× on T/³He (worst factor 1.58× incl. the anomalous deuteron) vs worst 2.01× pinned-on-D. The deuteron is anomalously weakly bound ⇒ a poor calibration anchor. α is NOT Q_β and NOT a free fit.

deuteron_anomaly.note: The generic log-trace OVERSHOOTS the deuteron by ~1.27× (predicts 3.9 MeV vs 2.2 MeV observed): the deuteron is the most weakly bound light nucleus (barely bound, no excited state), so a generic hyperbolic-trace estimate over-predicts it. This is WHY pinning α on D is the wrong calibration.

B_lin_saturates.note: B_lin = α·s is bounded by α (s<1), so its miss grows with A (⁴He ≈ 7×). The linear-vs-log gap is one truncation: −ln(1−s) vs s, at fixed α and fixed trace.

B_sym_generic_form.note: At the derived E_0 the exact log-trace lands within ~1.2× for the non-anomalous A=3 nuclei (T, ³He) with NO fit, and is the only form that resolves the T/³He splitting.

He4_needs_magic_volume.note: ⁴He is doubly-magic (no single hyperbolic knot): the log-trace undershoots ~2.4×, while the trace-free magic volume B = 2·m_e·A·8G lands at +5.9% (0.94×). B_magic is NOT a competing pipeline — it is the correct doubly-magic specialization where the per-knot trace does not exist.

extended_A_ge_4.note: ⁶Li / ⁷Li (computed live via the transfer path) undershoot like ⁴He: beyond A=3 the per-knot trace forms miss the shell/magic physics (~1.5–1.6×). Reported to bound where the single-pipeline trace estimate ceases to track AME, not as a closure.

T_vs_3He_splitting.note: B_AME, the exact-trace B_sym, AND the bond-type FACTORIZED q-CLT all split T from ³He; the uniform-bond B_qCLT predicts them EQUAL (same A, same bond count). T is more bound because it carries an n-n bond (L_nn=0.9073) where ³He carries a p-p bond (L_pp=0.4899) — the factorized q-CLT recovers the split through composition alone.

delta_lambda_for_2316.definition: Δ_λ = B_AME / B_pred at α = E_0 (derived). Δ_λ^lin uses the LINEAR B_pred = α·s (PR #2316's definition); Δ_λ^sym uses the EXACT log/exp form B_sym = α·ln(tr_free/tr_atom) (the Kashaev volume tr ~ exp(Vol)).
delta_lambda_for_2316.finding: The Kashaev log-trace B_sym absorbs most of #2316's exp-vs-linear Δ_λ: Δ_λ^lin grows ~0.9→8× with A (the 5–40× gap #2316 attributes to a q₀^5-per-site mechanism), while Δ_λ^sym stays ≈ 1 on the non-anomalous A=3 nuclei (T 1.279, ³He 1.58). So that mechanism, if it IS the exp-vs-linear gap, is already realized by B_sym for T/³He; the residual Δ_λ^sym ≠ 1 is confined to the deuteron anomaly and the magic-shell (⁴He / Li) deficit, NOT a uniform per-site factor.

B_qCLT_factorized.form: B_qCLT = α·Σ_i ln|V_i|, V_i = 2-nucleon sub-braid trace ratio per bond type (p-p / p-n / n-n) from the same transfer path. allpairs = literal complete-graph Σ (C(Z,2) p-p + Z·N p-n + C(N,2) n-n bonds; overcounts ~A² at large A). chain = (A−1) bonds at the composition-weighted mean (physically scaled).
B_qCLT_factorized.vs_uniform_note: Uniform B_qCLT_chain (ℓ̄ = L(deuteron) for every bond) cannot split T/³He; the factorized form does. Refines the appendix claim that ONLY B_sym splits them — bond-TYPE resolution suffices. all-pairs overbinds increasingly with A (complete graph unphysical); the (A−1) chain form is the sensible A→∞ self-averaged scaling.

T_vs_3He_split.note: B_AME, the exact-trace B_sym, AND the bond-type FACTORIZED q-CLT all split T from ³He; the uniform-bond B_qCLT predicts them EQUAL (same A, same bond count). T is more bound because it carries an n-n bond (L_nn=0.9073) where ³He carries a p-p bond (L_pp=0.4899) — the factorized q-CLT recovers the split through composition alone.
